description.intro: The Puma Serie A 26 27 Cup T.5 Stellar Hi-Vis ball is designed to offer excellent performance in training and amateur matches. Inspired by the official ball of the Italian Serie A, it combines resistance, good touch and great durability to withstand sessions of frequent use. Its abrasion-resistant construction and high-visibility design provide reliable and consistent behavior on every play, making it easy to track the ball during the game.

Stable flight: Construction designed to promote precise trajectories.
Gran durabilidad: Excelente resistencia al desgaste durante el uso frecuente.
High visibility: Its striking design makes it easy to locate and track the ball during the game.

Su construcción resistente a la abrasión y su diseño de alta visibilidad proporcionan un comportamiento fiable y consistente en cada jugada, facilitando el seguimiento del balón durante el juego.
